text: Rates just dropped into the low 6s! We locked in at 3.75% back in 2021 so we've been sitting on our hands, but this might finally be worth revisiting. Anyone actually pulling the trigger on a refi right now? Who did you use and what are you seeing?
comment_source_reason: Homeowners announcing they're refinancing after a rate drop are exactly the MLO's buyer segment (refi candidates), and this kind of thread reliably pulls in competing loan officers, brokers and banks pitching in the comments — high lead density and high competitor density for an MLO client.
